title: Bundle manifest v3 (variant spine + evidence view)
$comment: Structural residue of the evidence.* / claims.* bundle rules (P0-1, P0-0 invariants 5/11, P0-1 invariant 21). v3 makes the selected variant spine, claim contract, input-snapshot refs (with anchor status and time_basis, claims.offline-snapshot.policy-only), the EvidenceViewID, and a durable commitment (auditor signature or signed checkpoint, claims.vector.durable-commit) explicit, so an offline verifier fetches exact variants and can check the boundary commitment. The anchorStatus enum and time_basis semantics are p0-2-gated (values fixed by the P0-2 trusted-time decision). $defs are inlined (no cross-file $ref). v1/v2 reads remain supported (evidence.bundle.reader-first); v3 is not asserted verifiable by a v1/v2 reader.

spine.$comment: evidence.manifest.spine: the selected (BodyAddress, WireVariantID) spine the exporter fetched exact variants for.

inputSnapshotRefs.$comment: claims.offline-snapshot.policy-only: carried snapshots are policy state; the bundle states anchor status and time_basis and does not imply trusted observation time. anchorStatus enum and time_basis semantics are p0-2-gated.

commitment.$comment: claims.vector.durable-commit: the evidence view crossing the bundle boundary is committed by an auditor signature or a signed checkpoint reference.
